Hr. Kenneth F. Plumb, Secretary Federal Power Commission 825 North Capital Street Washington, D.C. 20426
RE: Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project FPC Project No. 2740 - South Carolina Duke File No. BK-1410.01
Dear Mr. Plumb:
Please refer to our December 22, 1975 letter proposing a schedule to submit to the Federal Power Commission additional information to update the license application and comments on the Draft Environmental Statement.
In accordance with our proposed schedule, we are enclosing 10 copies of the following:
1) Amendment I consisting of revisions and changes to the license application, Exhibits J, K, L, M, R, and S, and Exhibit W, as described in the enclosed list of pages, tables and figures affected by the amended.
2) Duke's comments on the Commission's Draft Environmental Impact Statement, except for items affecting need for power and construction schedule.
We are having delivered to Mr. C. M. Payne, Bureau of Power, Room 4110, Division of Licensed Projects, 65 copies of the Amendment I, including reduced size prints, as follows:
a) 4 packages of 5 Amendments
b) I package of 4 Amendments
c) 4 packages of 3 Amendments
d) The remaining 32 Amendments
We plan to submit additional amendments to the application, which would affect Exhibits I, N, O, U, V and W, and comments on items pertaining to need for power and construction schedule on March 29, 1976.
Yours very truly,
WTJ Ower
W. H. Owen
